title: Analyst, Risk Management
jobDescription:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), Bill Me (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

ROLE: Analyst – Risk Management

Job Summary

This is a permanent role that requires strong knowledge and experience in the merchant acquiring side of the payments business. The role focuses on merchant onboarding, KYC due diligence, website assessment, transaction monitoring, fraud detection, and ongoing merchant risk monitoring. The candidate will be responsible for identifying suspicious activities through data analysis and recommending appropriate risk mitigation measures.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Perform merchant due diligence, KYC validation, website assessment, and merchant onboarding reviews.
  • Monitor merchant transactions, identify abnormal patterns, and detect potential fraud or policy violations.
  • Conduct detailed investigations into suspicious merchant activities and recommend appropriate risk actions.
  • Perform merchant monitoring using transaction trends, behavioural analysis, and risk indicators.
  • Analyze transaction data using Excel and prepare review reports.
  • Handle merchant escalations and exception cases from business and operations teams.
  • Maintain clear communication with merchants through emails and calls.
  • Have a good understanding of merchant onboarding processes and payment risk controls.
  • Knowledge of chargebacks, card scheme guidelines, and fraud monitoring will be an added advantage.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Relevant experience in Merchant Risk, Transaction Monitoring, Fraud Risk, Merchant Acquiring, or Payment Operations.
  • Hands-on experience in merchant monitoring and fraud identification.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in transaction data analysis.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Knowledge of chargebacks, Visa/Mastercard guidelines, and fraud-related reason codes is preferred.

Core Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to identify suspicious transaction patterns and anomalies.
  • Good stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in Hindi and English is preferred.

Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to work in rotational shifts.
  • Willingness to provide support on weekends and public holidays, based on business requirements.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while meeting defined SLAs and TATs.

Location: Bangalore

Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.

title: Group Manager, Sales Enablement
jobDescription:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), Bill Me (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

Role Summary

Lead the Partnerships function for Razorpay POS by building and scaling the System Integrator (SI), Referral, and Strategic Partner ecosystem to drive merchant acquisition, payment volumes, and value-added services. Own partner strategy, commercial governance, GTM execution, and cross-functional program management while acting as the primary interface between business, product, engineering, finance, legal, banking partners, and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Partnership Strategy & Growth

  • Define and execute the partner strategy for System Integrators, Referral Partners, OEMs, Banks, and Enterprise ecosystem partners.
  • Build scalable partnership programs that drive merchant acquisition, POS deployments, and revenue growth.
  • Identify and onboard strategic partners aligned with Razorpay's long-term business objectives.

Commercials & Partner Governance

  • Lead commercial negotiations, pricing frameworks, revenue-sharing models, and partnership agreements.
  • Establish governance mechanisms to ensure commercial viability, financial controls, and scalable partner operations.
  • Drive commercial approvals in collaboration with Finance and Leadership while maintaining standardized contracting processes.

Go-to-Market (GTM) & Business Enablement

  • Design and execute joint GTM initiatives with partners to accelerate enterprise and mid-market merchant acquisition.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Enterprise, and Banking teams to create scalable partner-led acquisition channels.
  • Enable partner-led cross-selling of payment solutions and value-added services.

Program Management & Cross-functional Leadership

  • Drive end-to-end execution of strategic partnership initiatives by collaborating with Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, Risk, and Banking teams.
  • Own partner escalations, program governance, and executive stakeholder communication.
  • Ensure timely delivery of strategic initiatives while balancing business priorities and operational efficiency.

Partner Success & Ecosystem Development

  • Build long-term strategic relationships with key partner leadership teams.
  • Drive partner enablement through onboarding, training, solution adoption, and business reviews.
  • Monitor partner performance through defined KPIs and implement growth plans to maximize business outcomes.

Business Planning & Executive Reporting

  • Track and report partnership performance across merchant acquisition, integrated TIDs, revenue contribution, and strategic initiatives.
  • Present business updates, growth opportunities, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Develop scalable operating frameworks to improve partner productivity and organizational efficiency.

Key Outcomes

  • Scale the SI and Referral Partner ecosystem
  • Enable Referral and Integrator-led deployments
  • Establish partnerships as a strategic acquisition channel for enterprise merchants and POS growth.
  • Built governance frameworks for partner onboarding, commercial approvals, and standardized agreements.
  • Lead strategic negotiations with software partners, banks, and enterprise ecosystem players to unlock new revenue opportunities while mitigating commercial and operational risk.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic Partnerships
  • Partner Ecosystem Development
  • GTM Strategy & Execution
  • Enterprise Business Development
  • Commercial Negotiations
  • Program & Portfolio Management
  • Cross-functional Leadership
  • Banking & Fintech Partnerships
  • Revenue Growth & Business Strategy
  • Executive Communication
  • Process Design & Governance
  • Payment Integration Understanding

jobDescription:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

title: Staff Data Privacy Engineer
jobDescription:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), Bill Me (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

ROLE: Staff Data Privacy Engineer

This is the operational core of Razorpay's privacy function — a senior IC role that translates the Head's strategy into day-to-day technical execution, while directly leading a Lead Compliance Engineer and owning the tooling, assessments, and AI governance pipeline.

This role requires someone who can hold the space between strategy and execution — not just translate the Head's vision downward, but build the actual machinery that makes privacy operations run. As a Staff IC, you will technically lead a Lead Compliance Engineer and own the delivery of everything from AI tool onboarding to DPIA automation. Regulatory fluency is the floor. What differentiates the right candidate is their ability to build, automate, and lead — in an AI-first compliance environment that has no historical playbook.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

A. Privacy Programme Management & Regulatory Operations

  • Own the operationalisation of DPDP Act 2023 and GDPR requirements across Razorpay products, systems, and vendor stack — in coordination with the Head.
  • Manage and continuously improve the Record of Processing Activities (Ro PA), consent framework, data subject rights workflows, and data classification register.
  • Lead execution of Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) and Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) — with increasing automation over time.
  • Oversee cross-border data transfer compliance: SCCs, adequacy decisions, and DPDP cross-border transfer rules.
  • Coordinate with the Head for regulatory audits (RBI / SEBI), data privacy reviews, and incident reporting timelines.
  • Enforce consent, purpose limitation, data minimisation, and retention policies in live production system

B. Technical Privacy Posture & Assessment Delivery

  • Lead and personally conduct infrastructure privacy reviews of cloud environments (AWS / GCP / Azure) — access controls, encryption, data residency, audit logging.
  • Drive vendor and Saa S tool assessments beyond standard questionnaires — review actual data flows, API integrations, and technical configurations.
  • Own the technical quality of privacy assessments produced by the team — review, calibrate, and ensure
    regulatory alignment.
  • Monitor control effectiveness across production systems; identify gaps and partner with engineering to define remediation.
  • Build and maintain the team's assessment methodology, templates, and scoring frameworks.

C. AI Systems Privacy & Governance (LLM-Focused)

  • Own Razorpay's AI tool onboarding and privacy review process — from intake to sign-off.
  • Lead privacy assessments of LLM-powered tools, internal AI agents, and third-party AI integrations, with focus on data input, storage, retention, and cross-border sharing.
  • Build and maintain the AI privacy onboarding framework: checklists, risk registers, approval workflows, and exception management.
  • Define and document AI-specific privacy risks: prompt data leakage, model memory, third-party AI provider data usage, and agentic system data access.
  • Embed Privacy-by-Design into AI product lifecycles — engaging product and engineering teams from ideation through to inference.
  • Track third-party AI provider privacy policies (Open AI, Anthropic, Google, etc.) and maintain a current compliance alignment register

D. Compliance Automation & AI-Powered Privacy Operations

  • Design, build, and maintain AI-assisted compliance workflows — DPIA generation, evidence collection, control testing, and risk flagging.
  • Create and maintain compliance dashboards that give engineering, product, and leadership real-time visibility into privacy posture.
  • Develop standardised playbooks, checklists, and templates that enable product teams to self-serve privacy reviews with confidence.
  • Evaluate and validate the accuracy and regulatory alignment of AI-generated compliance outputs before they are accepted as formal evidence.
  • Continuously improve the team's tooling stack — GRC platforms, privacy management tools, AI assistants — for maximum operational leverage.

E. Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Technically lead, mentor, and develop the Lead Compliance Engineer — Privacy; set clear technical goals, unblock work, and drive their professional growth.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for engineering, product, legal, and business teams on day-to-day privacy
    matters.
  • Translate privacy requirements and risk findings into actionable, prioritised guidance for technical and non- technical stakeholders.
  • Support the Head with board-level and leadership reporting — prepare data, evidence packages, and risk summaries.
  • Maintain the privacy incident register, manage incident response timelines, and ensure regulatory reporting deadlines are met.
  • Drive a culture of privacy-as-enabler within the organisation — position compliance as a feature, not a gate.

What will set you apart:

  • Hands-on DPDP, GDPR implementation experience
  • Building privacy automation tooling from scratch ·
  • Prior assessment work on AI or LLM-powered products
  • Experience supporting regulatory examinations in a Fin Tech context.
Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
